job_title: Build a Talent Marketplace Using Bubble.io's Ready-to-Use Template
job_description:
Dear Developer,

We're looking for a talented developer to help us create a talent marketplace using Bubble.io's ready-to-use template. Our goal is to build a platform that will connect job seekers and employers in a seamless and user-friendly manner.

To achieve this, we need an experienced developer who can work with Bubble.io's pre-built template we purchased and integrate the necessary features and functionalities into our marketplace. 

We're looking for someone who has experience with Bubble.io and has a strong understanding of UI/UX design principles. Additionally, we would prefer someone who has experience building marketplaces or job boards.

If you're interested in taking on this project, please let us know about your relevant experience and provide us with a timeline and cost estimate. We're excited to work with you to create an innovative and user-friendly talent marketplace.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
proposal: You need a talent marketplace built on the Bubble.io template you've purchased — connecting job seekers and employers with search, dashboards, and payments. My closest marketplace work is an appointment-booking platform (React/Node/MongoDB) that handled multi-user roles, scheduling workflows, and payment integration — core patterns that map directly to a talent marketplace. I also delivered an LMS MVP with role-based access and content management, and rebuilt a marketing site (Next.js/Tailwind) that lifted mobile PageSpeed from 31 to 94 and increased leads 41% in two months, proving responsive, performance-focused UI work. I haven't built on Bubble.io yet, but I've customized template-based stacks (Next.js static sites, headless CMS) and pick up new low-code platforms quickly thanks to full-stack React/Node experience.

job_description:

AWS Amplify is used for web hosting and for backend data models with GraphQL.

The app should be offline-first and can be created under a single codebase (Expo with Next) or a monorepo with a Next web app and Expo React Native app using the same Amplify data source.

I would like to connect, show the work done thus far, determine a project setup, and hand off to continue developing features after discussing estimated effort.
proposal: You need a personal inventory app that works offline-first on web and mobile, backed by AWS Amplify and a shared GraphQL data layer — either as an Expo+Next monorepo or a single codebase. I recently built a Next.js storefront on the Shopify Storefront GraphQL API with ISR and a custom cart, lifting conversion 22% and LCP under 1.5 s. That project used Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQL end-to-end, which maps closely to the web side of your stack. I have not yet shipped a production app on AWS Amplify or built with React Native/Expo, so I would treat the Amplify data-model setup and the offline-first sync layer as the first milestones we define together. The closest mobile-adjacent work I've done is responsive web apps with Next.js and real-time features via WebSockets. I'd like to hop on a short call to review your current Amplify schema, agree on the monorepo structure, and outline the first two-week sprint.

job_title: Data analysis tracking stock changes (sales history) by a competitor
job_description:
Looking into a software which can track the history of stock values from one of my competitors.
The stock values are declared in the front end of the product page.
Need to be in a visualization (diagram) along with timestamp of when the changes was made, and when the product was created by the crawler.
The crawler needs to support proxies and multi thread.

Looking into a software for stock monitoring of my competitors to track their sales, based on the fluctuations of their inventory.

Data to being processed
Product name
Price
Stock values (along with time stamp)
Time stamp of when the row was created (so I can track if there is any new products that have been added)

The data needs to be updated daily, stock values need to be ina visualization (diagram) so that I can track which product that performs well.
The competitor of my choice (have 2 others that will be in the scope within the time) declare the stock value within the front end code.
The data is also based on the options of the website, which will include different selections.
Every option will need to include the product title + the option name along with price and stock values in a own row.
The urlers should be gotten from the sitemap as the competitor may add new product urls over the time.

Let me know your fixed price tag and estimated time.
proposal: You need a daily crawler that pulls competitor stock levels from product-page front-end code, handles variants via sitemap URLs, runs on proxies with multi-threading, and visualizes inventory trends with timestamps. I haven't built a production scraper with proxy rotation and multi-threading, but I have used Python and pandas extensively for large-scale data pipelines — most recently mining 2 million retail receipts to surface cross-sell bundles that lifted pilot-store sales 6%. That work required cleaning messy transaction data, scheduling repeatable runs, and delivering visual summaries stakeholders actually used. The closest related deliverable was a reusable A/B-test analysis notebook with confidence intervals that stopped false rollouts and identified a 4.2% conversion winner. I can apply the same rigor to structuring your stock-change dataset and building the visualization layer.

job_description:
I am looking for a specialist in PowerBI that can extract data from a SCADA Server using ODBC and SQL Queries. I have a SCADA Database that can be accessed using ODBC and SQL Queries. With the SCADA System, I have a visual data representation already build, but I would like to build out a similar representation of this but with Power BI. We specialize in tank monitoring and remote monitoring systems. Our clients have access to view their SCADA Data but the mobile version falls a little short. I am looking for someone that can recommend solutions as well as implement data representation in a clean, quick, user friendly web based mobile version. I have a Server where we can run PowerBI locally or I'm open to other cloud based options. 

A couple of things that are important and required.

1) Each company will have their own set of users so user management is important.
2) The ODBC data is accessible but must be queried using an ID and date.
3) I'd like to be able to view live data, so refresh is important. 
4) I'd like clients to be able to view historical data and be able to access it in a quick and easy fashion.
5) I prefer each client accessing their data to not have to create microsoft accounts, rather use a local authentication method (if possible)
6) I work with tank levels so visual representation of tanks is important.

I am also interested in determining if it is possible to create my own mobile app for accessing this PowerBI dashboard.
proposal: You need a Power BI specialist who can pull live SCADA data via ODBC/SQL, serve multiple clients with isolated access, and deliver a mobile-friendly tank-monitoring dashboard without forcing Microsoft accounts. I recently built a daily-refreshed Power BI sales dashboard for a Karachi FMCG distributor that 45 regional managers now use weekly — cutting monthly reporting from three days to zero. That project required star-schema modeling, row-level security for multi-user access, and scheduled refresh over SQL — the same patterns your SCADA use case demands. I can set up DirectQuery or incremental refresh for near-real-time tank levels, implement workspace/app-based isolation so each company sees only its data, and design tank-visual custom visuals that render cleanly on mobile browsers. For authentication, I'll evaluate Power BI Embedded with token-based auth or Azure AD B2C so your clients avoid Microsoft logins.

job_title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer - Voice Cloning and Text-to-Speech Development
job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and lead the development of an AI application for our organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating a personal text-to-speech bot, paired with an avatar that closely resembles our CEO through the use of thousands of hours of audio recordings.

Key Responsibilities:

-Develop, test and deploy a machine learning model for voice cloning
-Create a text-to-speech application that can mimic the CEO's voice
-Collaborate with the team to integrate the voice cloning and text-to-speech technology with an avatar
-Continuously improve and optimize the voice cloning and text-to-speech technology
-Stay up to date with the latest advancements in the field and apply them to the project

Qualifications:

-Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
-Strong experience in machine learning and natural language processing
-Experience in voice cloning, text-to-speech, and speech synthesis
-Strong programming skills in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow and PyTorch
-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a team
-Good communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
-Experience leading a team is a plus
proposal: You are looking for a personal text-to-speech bot and an avatar that mimics the CEO's voice using thousands of hours of audio recordings. While I have not developed a specific voice cloning model from scratch, I have built a speech-to-text pipeline using Whisper and ffmpeg for meeting transcription and summary tools, which demonstrates my ability to handle complex audio processing pipelines. My broader experience with TensorFlow and Deep Learning, used in projects like Roman-Urdu sentiment analysis where I achieved a Macro-F1 of 0.82, allows me to adapt these technical capabilities to the complex task of voice cloning. I am proficient in Python and have extensive experience with Amazon Web Services for model deployment, where I reduced deployment time from days to under an hour. My background in Natural Language Processing and Deep Learning provides the strong foundation needed to implement and optimize a voice cloning system. Let's discuss how I can apply my audio processing and deep learning expertise to your CEO's voice cloning project.
